primaryMinimalDefense.proposal: Add explicit !input.PointerPressedOverUi alongside shared dragging check before held Pan. Optional early UI-owned return only if existing selection/scan/release/cancel lifecycle remains intact.
primaryMinimalDefense.why: Defends a classified UI-origin stream against a distinct post-press drag-flag writer; does not repair a missed initial hit or prove the blank-view cause.
primaryMinimalDefense.prerequisite: Review and joint existing-fixture coverage, including positive world drag; no native proof claimed.

separateConditionalCenterProposal.proposal: If reviewed desired behavior is retain-current-ground-center, capture center before lens change and queue the same existing MoveGroundCenterTo after perspective change, following ExitNormalIsoMode pattern.
separateConditionalCenterProposal.prerequisite: Establish actual fullscreen-exit involvement and desired restoration semantics; test normal plane/bounds and portrait/wide view. Do not reset to base or change geometry.

aircraftRestorePolicy.proposal: No unconditional patch. First establish Applied aircraft context and whether UX should retain current actor area or restore prior manual center; use existing owner/request APIs only.
aircraftRestorePolicy.prerequisite: Exact actor/session/camera evidence and Windows owner decision; preserve paid production identity and Follow authority.

nonChanges: No troop orders from camera guidance or card-scroll handling
No automatic base focus/teleport on every card click
No global ground clamp added to tactical Follow/aircraft/placement (existing tests intentionally exempt these)
No new diagnostic framework, source integration, Unity/native/Library/process control
